security.note: snailmail defines NO own res.groups and NO record rules; the 2 ir.model.access rows scope snailmail.letter to base.group_user (read/write/create, no unlink) and base.group_system (full). Attachment confidentiality is enforced in Python: create()/write() call letters.attachment_id.check_access('read') so a user can only attach a document they may read. All IAP/print side-effects run sudo().

views.note: Only a list + form on snailmail.letter (+ a 'Snailmail Letters' act_window under base.menu_email). The user-facing surface is the chatter: a posted message of message_type='snailmail' with Send/Cancel buttons and the SnailmailNotificationPopover, not a dedicated app.

behavioral_notes.observation: _snailmail_print (snailmail_letter.py:347) partitions self into valid/invalid by _is_valid_address (requires street, city, zip, country_id); invalid letters go straight to state='error' / error_code='MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELDS' with the notification flipped to 'exception'. For each valid letter it calls _snailmail_print_valid_address and self.env.cr.commit() after EACH one (so a later rollback never re-sends an already-printed letter). _snailmail_print_valid_address reads ir.config_parameter 'snailmail.endpoint' (default https://iap-snailmail.odoo.com) + 'snailmail.timeout' (30s), builds the payload via _snailmail_create('print'), and POSTs through odoo.addons.iap.tools.iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc(endpoint + '/iap/snailmail/1/print'). The payload carries the iap.account('snailmail').account_token, database.uuid, per-document recipient + return address blocks, the base64 PDF (pdf_bin), company logo, and color/cover/duplex options. Response docs with sent==True + request_code==200 -> state='sent' + tracking note 'The tracking id is <send_id>'; otherwise the per-doc error string is mapped to state='error'. AccessError from IAP is re-raised after marking letters UNKNOWN_ERROR. Entirely invisible to ORM metadata.

create() (snailmail_letter.py:89, @api.model_create_multi) is NOT a passive insert: for each letter it first message_post(body='Letter sent by post with Snailmail', message_type='snailmail') on the SOURCE record (self.env[vals['model']].browse(vals['res_id'])), stores that mail.message in message_id, and snapshots the recipient's street/street2/zip/city/state_id/country_id onto the letter (so the mailed address is frozen at creation). After super().create it bulk-creates one mail.notification per letter with notification_type='snail', notification_status='ready', is_read=True (so it never clutters Inbox) — this is the row the Discuss delivery icon and SnailmailNotificationPopover read. Finally letters.attachment_id.check_access('read') enforces attachment ACL. So creating a snailmail.letter mutates the chatter of an unrelated business document.

behavioral_notes.element: snailmail.letter IAP credit gate + error->failure_type mapping (no local ledger)
behavioral_notes.observation: There is no local credit balance in this module; credit is metered on the remote service. When the print response carries error 'CREDIT_ERROR', _snailmail_print_valid_address calls iap.account._send_no_credit_notification(service_name='snailmail', title='Not enough credits for Snail Mail') and _get_error_message builds an HTML link to iap.account.get_credits_url('snailmail') so the user can top up. _get_error_message / _get_failure_type translate the wire error codes (CREDIT_ERROR, TRIAL_ERROR, NO_PRICE_AVAILABLE, MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELDS, FORMAT_ERROR, TOO_MANY_PAGES, UNKNOWN_ERROR) into mail.notification.failure_type values sn_credit / sn_trial / sn_price / sn_fields / sn_format / sn_error, which drive mail.message.snailmail_error and the red delivery badge. The data/iap_service_data.xml registers iap.service 'snailmail' (unit_name 'Stamps', integer_balance) as the IAP product. Credit pricing/coverage lives entirely on iap-snailmail.odoo.com.

data/snailmail_data.xml defines ir.cron 'snailmail_print' running model._snailmail_cron() every 24 hours. _snailmail_cron (snailmail_letter.py:449) re-searches letters in state='pending' OR state='error' with a *recoverable* error_code (TRIAL_ERROR, CREDIT_ERROR, ATTACHMENT_ERROR, MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELDS) and re-runs _snailmail_print on each, committing after every send; crucially it breaks the loop the moment a letter returns CREDIT_ERROR to 'avoid spam' (one failed credit check stops the batch so it doesn't burn through retries). state flows pending -> sent | error | canceled; snailmail_print() resets a letter to pending and re-sends if a singleton; cancel() sets canceled and notification_status='canceled'. Non-recoverable errors (e.g. FORMAT_ERROR, NO_PRICE_AVAILABLE) are NOT retried by the cron.

When no attachment exists, _fetch_attachment renders the report_template (or the report named in context) to PDF via ir.actions.report.with_context(snailmail_layout=not cover, lang='en_US')._render_qweb_pdf, but FIRST enforces an A4 paperformat (raises UserError 'Please use an A4 Paper format.' otherwise) and temporarily swaps unsupported external_report_layout_id (bubble/wave/folder) to web.external_layout_standard for the render, restoring it after. The PDF is then run through _overwrite_margins (paints white reportlab rectangles over the 5mm postal margins + bottom-left franking square) and, if cover is set, _append_cover_page (reportlab Canvas writes the recipient address into a window-envelope frame, inserting a blank page first when duplex). The ir.actions.report override retrieve_attachment returns False under snailmail_layout to force a fresh render, and get_paperformat forces base.paperformat_euro (except for the l10n_de DIN5008 layout). This is real PDF engineering for window-envelope postal compliance, fully outside metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: res.partner address propagation + snailmail country/address formatting
behavioral_notes.observation: res.partner.write override (models/res_partner.py): when any of street/street2/city/zip/state_id/country_id changes, it searches snailmail.letter rows in state not in ('sent','canceled') for that partner and writes the new address onto them — so editing a contact updates the queued (not-yet-sent) letters' frozen address. _get_country_name returns the English country name from country_utils.SNAILMAIL_COUNTRIES when snailmail_layout is set (the postal carrier requires English country names), and _get_address_format collapses street/street2 onto one line, with a special DE branch ('%(street)s // %(street2)s', zip+city) for Pingen (the German postal provider). mail.thread.notify_cancel_by_type('snail') -> _notify_cancel_snail cancels the current author's in-flight letters for that model.

5 JS files, 1 OWL component (SnailmailNotificationPopover), 0 registry adds, 3 patches (Failure.prototype, MessagingMenu.prototype, Notification.prototype); asset bundles ['web.assets_backend' (1), 'snailmail.report_assets_snailmail' (5), 'web.assets_unit_tests' (1)]. The JS patches the Discuss/Messaging notification UI to surface snailmail delivery state (red failure badge, Send Letter / Cancel actions, the address popover) — it adds no new screen, it decorates the existing chatter/notification components. report_assets_snailmail is the SCSS/QWeb bundle for the postal PDF layout.

0 raw http_call_sites and no third-party SDK imports in this module; the only outbound HTTP is the printing call, brokered by odoo.addons.iap.tools.iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc to endpoint https://iap-snailmail.odoo.com (PRINT path /iap/snailmail/1/print), overridable via ir.config_parameter 'snailmail.endpoint'. uses_api_keys=false at this layer: auth is the per-account iap.account('snailmail').account_token + database.uuid, not a user-held API key. The physical-mail fulfilment, franking, postage pricing and per-country coverage all live on the remote Odoo IAP service (and its downstream postal carriers, e.g. Pingen for DE). reportlab is a local PDF dependency, not a network SDK.

it_architecture.application: snailmail (Snail Mail - a physical-letter egress channel layered on mail's notification pipeline, posting documents via Odoo IAP)
logical_data_erm: snailmail.letter -> mail.message (message_id; the chatter status message)
snailmail.letter -> res.company (company_id; return address + print defaults)
snailmail.letter -> (model, res_id) generic reference to the source business document

side-effect: snailmail.letter.create -> message_post(message_type='snailmail') on source record + mail.notification(type='snail') + address snapshot + attachment ACL check

capabilities: Send a business document as physical post (queue + print via IAP)
Postal PDF preparation (A4/euro layout, margin masking, window-envelope cover page)
Physical-mail delivery tracking & failure handling (state machine + notification badge)
Recipient address validation & freezing (street/city/zip/country, English country names, DE/Pingen formatting)
IAP credit gate + top-up redirect for postage
value_streams: Send-by-Post: action creates snailmail.letter -> message_post + notification -> render PDF -> _snailmail_print -> IAP /iap/snailmail/1/print -> sent + tracking id, or error
Queued-Retry: ir.cron _snailmail_cron -> re-send pending + recoverable-error letters -> break on credit error
Address-Correction: edit res.partner address -> propagate to in-flight letters -> next send uses corrected address
organization: base.group_system (full access incl. unlink + IAP/print config)
(snailmail defines no own groups; 2 access rules + Python attachment ACL)
policies: Address completeness gate: _is_valid_address requires street, city, zip, country_id before any IAP call -> else MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELDS / sn_fields

Paper compliance: non-A4 paperformat raises UserError; unsupported report layouts swapped to standard for the postal render
Recoverable vs terminal errors: only TRIAL/CREDIT/ATTACHMENT/MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELDS are retried by the cron

Recipient contact (res.partner with a postal address)
System/admin (sets print defaults, manages IAP snailmail account/credit)
Odoo IAP Snail Mail service + downstream postal carriers (e.g. Pingen) — external physical fulfilment

IAP snailmail credit balance / 'Stamps' consumed (iap.account, remote)

classification.rationale: snailmail is a cross-cutting SUPPORT subsystem (Stabell & Fjeldstad 'support'): a physical-mail egress CHANNEL, not part of any single primary value chain. It is the postal sibling of sms and mail - it plugs into mail.thread's notification pipeline (message_type='snailmail', notification_type='snail', mail.notification.failure_type sn_*) and reuses mail.message / mail.notification, so any business document (most often an account.move invoice or follow-up report) can be mailed with no schema change. auto_install=True with mail/iap_mail confirms it is shared messaging/communication infrastructure consumed by accounting (account_followup, l10n_* invoice posting) rather than a selling or finance activity in itself. APQC best fit is 9.4 'Manage internal communications' - the firm-wide communication-channel category that also houses mail and sms; chosen over an 8.x IT code because the substance is a *communication delivery channel* (compose -> deliver a document to a recipient), not IT-service plumbing, and over a 9.x finance code because snailmail itself is channel infrastructure (it merely carries finance documents, it does not own the ledger). The number 9.4 = 'Manage internal communications' matches the name used here. NOTE the external integration (gap #7): all printing goes through Odoo IAP (https://iap-snailmail.odoo.com /iap/snailmail/1/print) via iap_tools.iap_jsonrpc with a per-account token, and postage is a metered IAP credit ('Stamps').

standard_capabilities: Mail any printable Odoo document by post (Send by Post on the chatter, or snailmail_print)
Physical mail as a chatter/notification channel alongside email & SMS (message_type='snailmail')
Automatic postal-PDF preparation: A4/euro paperformat, 5mm margin masking, window-envelope cover page, duplex blank page
Recipient address validation (street/city/zip/country) and address freezing at queue time
Per-country address/Country-name normalisation (English names; DE/Pingen single-line formatting)
Delivery state machine + notification badge (pending/sent/error) with tracking id
Queued sending + 24h retry cron with credit-spam guard and per-letter commit
IAP snailmail account, postage credit ('Stamps') and buy-more redirect
typical_fits: Posting customer invoices and payment follow-ups physically (the canonical account_followup / invoicing use case)
Letting a user send a record's report by post from the chatter when email is not an option
Centralising postal print defaults (cover/color/duplex) per company
Surfacing postal delivery failures (insufficient credit, bad address) in Discuss for follow-up
common_gaps: Using a non-Odoo postal provider requires bypassing the hard-wired IAP endpoint /iap/snailmail/1/print (default is Odoo IAP only)
Only A4 / euro (and l10n_de DIN5008) paperformats are supported; other formats raise UserError
No inbound/return-mail or scan-back handling - delivery is one-way with a tracking id only
Postage pricing, country coverage and the 8-page limit (TOO_MANY_PAGES) are enforced remotely, not configurable locally
No mass/batch UI beyond the queue cron; bulk posting is driven by upstream modules creating letters

open_questions: Exact IAP wire contract / response schema of /iap/snailmail/1/print (sent flags, send_id tracking, per-doc error reasons) and credit/postage pricing live on iap-snailmail.odoo.com and are not reverse-engineerable from this module (gap #7).
Which downstream modules create snailmail.letter rows in practice (account_followup, invoice 'Send & Print') and how they batch them is outside this module.
Live IAP-dependent behavior - credit checks, per-country coverage, the 8-page TOO_MANY_PAGES limit, carrier routing (Pingen for DE) - cannot be observed without an activated database + credits.
Precise APQC leaf for a cross-cutting physical-comms channel (9.4 internal communications vs a 12.x external-relationship code) mirrors the open question on the mail/sms records.
